name: Gen Z Trend Breakdown
description: Trend explainer + reaction format — hook into the trend, break down why it's happening, deliver cultural context. Best for Gen Z culture, TikTok trends, meme breakdowns, and 'why is everyone talking about this' content.
voice_style: chatty, culturally fluent, slightly deadpan — speaks like a friend who is terminally online and proud of it; fast-paced energy, natural Gen Z cadence
music_mood: trending audio clips woven in, ironic meme music, hyperpop, or the actual trend's original sound as background reference

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Everyone on your FYP is talking about this trend. And here is why it actually says something really dark about our generation.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Split screen showing multiple examples of the trend from different creators, phone scrolling through viral videos, person in foreground looking confused then intrigued, text 'THE TREND EVERYONE IS TALKING ABOUT'
scene_sequence.camera_movement: phone screen recording simulation, split screen composition with person reacting in foreground
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: phone screen glow as primary light source on face, dark room, screen-light-only aesthetic
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Dark room + phone screen aesthetic is core to Gen Z visual language; split screen creates 'I know you know this' energy

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: The trend goes like this: [describe the trend in third person as if explaining to someone not on TikTok]. And it sounds ridiculous until you realize it's actually a coping mechanism for something very real — [insert cultural context about anxiety, economic pressure, social media fatigue, etc.].
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person talking directly to camera with on-screen text examples of the trend, meme format screenshotted, screen recordings of trend going viral, reaction faces stitched in, text callouts explaining subtext
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up direct address, quick cuts to screen recording inserts, static on face for insight moments
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: ring light key from slightly above, warm skin tones, secondary fill from monitor beside camera
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Direct address is king — eye contact with lens; screen recording inserts break monotony and boost relatability

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: The reason this hit so hard is Gen Z grew up being told to be unique while simultaneously being algorithmically pressured to conform. This trend is us laughing at that paradox — and also living inside it.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person delivering insight with expressive face, graphic showing algorithm funnel narrowing, meme format callout, ironic smile, cultural context graphic
scene_sequence.camera_movement: slow push-in on the insight delivery, hold for the ironic smile beat, graphic overlay
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: moody dramatic side lighting for insight moment, shift to brighter on ironic smile beat
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: The insight beat deserves cinematic treatment — hold on face for full impact, then release with ironic smile

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Do you relate to this trend or does it baffle you entirely? I need to know. Follow and drop a comment.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person pointing at comment section, laughing or shrugging, poll-style graphics appearing, follow button on screen, phone close-up showing comment section
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up, hand gesture toward comment section graphic, casual shrug or laugh
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: bright energetic lighting, warm tones, inviting and conversational
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Casual energy — this should feel like a group chat, not a broadcast; eye contact and warm energy essential
